n=int(input())
q=tuple(map(int,input().split()))
a=list(map(int,input().split()))
b=list(map(int,input().split()))
amax = min(q[i] // a[i] if a[i] != 0 else float('inf') for i in range(n))
bmax = min(q[i] // b[i] if b[i] != 0 else float('inf') for i in range(n))

max_servings = 0

for servings_a in range(amax + 1):
    remaining_ingredients = [q[i] - servings_a * a[i] for i in range(n)]
    servings_b = min(remaining_ingredients[i] // b[i] if b[i] != 0 else float('inf') for i in range(n))
    max_servings = max(max_servings, servings_a + servings_b)

print(max_servings)
